universities.summary: Loyola-ICAM College of Engineering and Technology is a private engineering college in the Loyola campus at Nungambakkam, Chennai. Its six undergraduate awards cover computing, electrical, electronics and mechanical engineering, with an English-medium curriculum and Anna University affiliation.
universities.campusLifestyle: The Loyola-campus setting combines engineering departments with a central library, laboratories, hostel facilities and student activities. The library provides print collections, electronic resources and NPTEL learning material. Canteen and kiosk facilities support the teaching day. Cover photo credit: Praveen rijal (2019), CC BY-SA 4.0; https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:LICET.jpg; https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Original unchanged.
universities.cityProfile: LICET is based at Loyola Campus in Nungambakkam, Chennai, rather than a separate out-of-city engineering campus. The housing decision is between an available campus-hostel place and accommodation with a workable daily journey to Nungambakkam. Students Traffic can help compare that practical choice alongside the selected engineering branch.
universities.practicalExposure: Engineering study includes laboratory and project work within the UG curriculum. Electrical engineering uses tools including MATLAB, MiPower, ETAP and Altair Flux; information technology adds virtual laboratories and free/open-source software activities. Mechanical engineering has automation and robotics-related learning. These facilities support academic practice, not a placement or internship guarantee.
universities.hostelOverview: Separate boys’ and girls’ hostels operate within the Loyola campus, with kitchens and dining areas. The hostel process follows college admission and includes meeting the hostel director with parents. A course place does not establish a current room allocation or hostel price.
universities.dietarySupport: LICET has a canteen and kiosk, and hostel kitchens have separate dining areas. Menus, allergy arrangements and special-diet availability are not established in this profile; allow for food preferences when planning the living budget.
universities.safetyOverview: An anti-ragging committee and squads handle complaints, awareness activities and preventive visits. These are defined reporting and prevention arrangements, not a guarantee of personal safety.
universities.studentSupport: A student counsellor provides personal support, while class advisers track registration, attendance and academic progress. Students Traffic can help compare the course route, document preparation and living-cost plan before an application.

faq.question: Is LICET the same institution as Loyola College?
faq.answer: No. LICET is the engineering college within the Loyola-campus setting. Its engineering awards, application route and college identity are separate from Loyola College’s arts and science programmes.

faq.question: Which undergraduate courses are included?
faq.answer: The six current awards are B.E. Computer Science and Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, B.Tech. Information Technology, and Artificial Intelligence and Data Science.

faq.question: How long is the standard engineering degree?
faq.answer: The HSC-entry undergraduate engineering route runs for four years across eight semesters. Lateral-entry regulations exist, but current lateral-entry vacancies are not represented as an open admission offer here.

faq.question: What is the teaching language?
faq.answer: English is used for teaching, examinations, seminars and project reports, except courses specifically taught in another language.

faq.question: What academic marks does the TNEA route require?
faq.answer: The academic route uses Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry. The minimum combined average is 45% for the general category and 40% for the listed reserved categories, alongside the other TNEA eligibility conditions.

faq.question: How do applicants approach government-quota seats?
faq.answer: Use TNEA registration, certificate verification and counselling, then select LICET and the preferred branch in the choice list. Allocation depends on the counselling process and available seats, not only the minimum qualifying marks.

faq.question: Is there a separate college application?
faq.answer: The 2026–27 college instructions provide an online application using a valid email and mobile number, academic information and document uploads. Submission follows Class 12 results; this does not by itself establish that a new application window remains open.

faq.question: Can an international applicant use these course listings?
faq.answer: These listings describe an evidenced domestic route. TNEA permits specified additional categories, including qualifying Tamil Nadu-native OCI/PIO applicants; the current AICTE approval does not authorize the listed NRI or international supernumerary quotas.

faq.question: Are tuition and accommodation included in one price?
faq.answer: No combined current price is established here. Annual tuition is on request, and any dated full-course planning estimate is separate from hostel, mess and other charges.

faq.question: Is campus accommodation available?
faq.answer: LICET has separate boys’ and girls’ hostels within the Loyola campus. Hostel allocation follows a separate process after college admission; no current room guarantee or tariff is included.

faq.question: What support is available during study?
faq.answer: Personal counselling and academic class-adviser support are available. Students Traffic can help organize a shortlist and document plan before applying, while the college handles its own admissions decisions.

eligibleAudiences: Indian applicants satisfying the applicable TNEA 2026 first-year route
Tamil Nadu-native OCI/PIO cardholders eligible for TNEA Open Category, subject to its foreign-birth cutoff
Sri Lankan Tamil refugees who studied in Tamil Nadu and satisfy the documented TNEA certificate route
restrictions: Only the documented 2026 first-year TNEA route is represented; this is not unrestricted foreign/NRI, management-quota or lateral-entry admission.
The OCI/PIO exception does not apply to candidates born in a foreign country after 4 March 2021. Tamil Nadu native status and the academic conditions must also be met.
Sri Lankan Tamil refugees must have studied in Tamil Nadu and provide the specified identification/camp-registration alternatives.
AICTE supernumerary NRI/FN/OCI/Gulf approval is No for 2026–27; that quota finding is distinct from the limited ordinary TNEA eligibility exceptions.
audienceEligibility.notes: Government TNEA 2026 college directory, code 1450 (printed page 108), lists this LICET branch. The common government brochure, printed page 2, positively defines the restricted OCI/PIO and refugee routes. No next-cycle opening or unrestricted international route is asserted.

admissionsContent.overview: The programme combines artificial intelligence and data-science study within a four-year engineering degree. The department focuses on using data and computational methods to address practical problems.

eligibility.intro: The academic first-year route uses the HSC qualification and Tamil Nadu engineering-admissions conditions.
items: Pass HSC academic (+1 and +2), or an accepted equivalent, with Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry.
For the TNEA academic route, the minimum combined average in Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry is 45% for the general category and 40% for the listed reserved categories.
TNEA nativity, schooling and category conditions apply; a qualifying mark does not guarantee allotment.
Tamil Nadu-native OCI/PIO applicants use Open Category; the exception excludes those born abroad after 4 March 2021.
Sri Lankan Tamil refugees who studied in Tamil Nadu may be considered under open competition under the documented certificate route.

applicationSteps: For a government-quota seat, register for TNEA and upload the academic and category certificates required for the applicable route.
Participate in certificate verification, ranking and the assigned online counselling round; enter LICET and the chosen engineering branch in the preference list.
Confirm the allotted option and complete the reporting and payment instructions within the counselling schedule.
For the college application route, register with a valid email and mobile number, complete academic details, upload the requested documents and submit after Class 12 results.

LICET is listed as an Anna University affiliated college in Chennai, examination code 3111 and TNEA code 1450.
LICET is the private self-financing engineering institution established in 2010, distinct from Loyola College; the current EOA lists six UG awards.
The central library supports electronic resources and NPTEL; the engineering college is within Loyola campus at Nungambakkam.
LICET address is Loyola Campus, Nungambakkam, Chennai; housing-versus-commute comparison is editorial planning guidance without travel-time or cost claims.
Separate boys and girls hostels within Loyola campus provide kitchen/dining areas; applicants meet the hostel director with parents after college admission.
Canteen and kiosk operate; hostel kitchens/dining areas are documented. No special-diet guarantee or price is inferred.
Anti-ragging committee/squads receive complaints, run awareness activities and preventive visits.
The institution provides a student counsellor; no outcome promise is made.
Class-adviser duties include registration, attendance, progress and academic counselling.
